questions.stem: A 42-year-old father lost his son in a tragic car accident in which he also sustained minor injuries. In the months following the accident, he has been persistently sad and frequently crying. He stopped going to work and experienced significant weight loss. He struggles with sleep and has considered suicide on a few occasions, but refrained from acting on those thoughts due to his religious beliefs. Based on the presented symptoms, what is the most likely diagnosis?
